text:
Oh my gosh, look! It’s a SNOW HOUSE! 🏠️

It’s made of BIG, BLOOMING ICE BRICKS like Lego but way cooler because it’s COLD and SHINY! And there’s a DOOR! A real wooden door! Like you can walk right in and play hide-and-seek inside with your friends!

And look at ALL the people! They’re all bundled up like marshmallows! 🧸 Some have red backpacks, some have blue hats, and one guy has a green backpack that looks like a turtle shell! One person is even wearing snowshoes—those are for walking on top of the snow so you don’t sink! Whoa!

There’s a little chimney on top! Is someone making hot cocoa inside? Or maybe roasting marshmallows?! I hope they saved me some!

The trees behind are bare and sleepy, but WE’RE WIDE AWAKE AND EXCITED! This is the BEST DAY EVER! Can we go inside? Please please please?? I wanna touch the ice walls! They probably feel like frozen jellybeans! 😋

Wait—is that Santa Claus hiding in there?? Nooo… just grown-ups. But still! So fun! Let’s build our own igloo tomorrow!! 🛷✨
